description: This PHP class 'InstallOnExistingDatabaseCommand' extends another command class and implements a CLI command for setting up or configuring an existing database for the OrangeHRM application. It handles database configuration prompts, validation, and connection checks within an installer setup process.

classes.name: InstallOnExistingDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A command class for installing or configuring an existing database connection for OrangeHRM via CLI, including user prompts and validation.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the CLI command name for this setup process.

methods.name: databaseInformation
methods.description: Interactive method to prompt user input for database connection info, validate, and ensure the database is ready for setup.
